label: default agent • quick knowledge question answered inline, no spawn
query: What's the difference between TCP and UDP, in two sentences?
notes: Inline-vs-delegate policy row: a short knowledge question fits in a few sentences from what the Orchestrator already knows, so it is answered directly — no `spawn_agent`, no agent creation via `osaurus_config`, no `osaurus_help` (not an Osaurus question), no web tools. Tool-free expectation keeps this runnable on tiny-window models where the tool schema is stripped.

rubric: Answers the question directly in the reply (TCP is connection-oriented/reliable/ordered; UDP is connectionless/best-effort/lower latency).
Does NOT delegate, create an agent, or say the question is out of scope.
Stays brief — about two sentences, no option menus or follow-up questions.
